label.administrable_evidence: The NIOSH National Construction Center serves as a national leader in construction research, implementation, and dissemination of scientific discoveries to benefit construction workers by working to prevent or reduce work-related injuries and illnesses.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity emphasizes the development of partnerships and capacity building, which aligns with the objective to invest in the capacity of partners to overcome persistent health disparities.
